gizmo.title: Bayanin ƙasa
gizmo.description: Bayanin da aka rubuta a inda ya dace a cikin rubutu. Yana bayyana a matsayin lamba, kuma jerin bayanan masu lamba yana gina kansa a ƙasan shafin.

configure.title: Babu samfoti
configure.description: Kada ka nuna bayanin idan mai karatu ya shawagi ko ya mayar da hankali kan lambar.
